name: recorded-future-feed
label: Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed
description:
Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed connector ingests indicators (IP, Domain, URL, Hash, Vulnerability) from the Recorded Future Connect API risklists and supports on-demand reputation lookups. Authentication uses an X-RFToken API token.

This connector has a dependency on the Threat Intel Management Solution Pack. Install the Solution Pack before enabling ingestion.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Indicator Type
ingestion_config_schema.name: indicator_type
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Recorded Future risklist to pull on each scheduled ingestion run.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Risk Rule (Optional)
ingestion_config_schema.name: risk_rule
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Optional Recorded Future risk rule name (e.g. 'cyberAttack', 'historicalThreatListMembership'). Leave blank to use the default master risklist for the chosen indicator type. Use the 'Get Risk Rules' action to discover valid rule names.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Reputation
ingestion_config_schema.name: reputation
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Default reputation applied to ingested indicators.

ingestion_config_schema.title: TLP
ingestion_config_schema.name: tlp
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Default TLP marking applied to ingested indicators.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Confidence
ingestion_config_schema.name: confidence
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Default confidence score applied when the feed record does not carry one.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Maximum Age (in days)
ingestion_config_schema.name: expiry
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Indicator expiry in days from ingestion time.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Per-Run Limit (Optional)
ingestion_config_schema.name: limit
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Optional cap on indicators ingested per run. Leave blank to ingest the full risklist.

fields.title: Base URL
fields.name: base_url
fields.description: Specify the Recorded Future Connect API base URL. Override this value only if you are using a regional API endpoint.
fields.tooltip: Specify the Recorded Future Connect API base URL. Override this value only if you are using a regional API endpoint.

fields.title: API Token
fields.name: api_token
fields.description: Specify the Recorded Future API token. This token is sent as the X-RFToken header with every API request.
fields.tooltip: Specify the Recorded Future API token. This token is sent as the X-RFToken header with every API request.

fields.title: Malicious Threshold
fields.name: malicious_threshold
fields.tooltip: Specify the risk score threshold at or above which an indicator is classified as Malicious. Accepted values range from 1 to 100, with a default value set as 65.
fields.description: Specify the risk score threshold at or above which an indicator is classified as Malicious. Accepted values range from 1 to 100, with a default value set as 65.

fields.title: Suspicious Threshold
fields.name: suspicious_threshold
fields.tooltip: Specify the risk score threshold at or above which an indicator is classified as Suspicious. The value must be lower than the Malicious Threshold. Accepted values range from 1 to 100, with a default value set as 25.
fields.description: Specify the risk score threshold at or above which an indicator is classified as Suspicious. The value must be lower than the Malicious Threshold. Accepted values range from 1 to 100, with a default value set as 25.

fields.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.name: timeout
fields.tooltip: Specify the HTTP request timeout duration in seconds. It will wait for the configured time before terminating the request.
fields.description: Specify the HTTP request timeout duration in seconds. It will wait for the configured time before terminating the request.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is set to True.
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is set to True.

operations.title: Fetch Indicators
operations.description: Fetch indicators of the specified type from the Recorded Future risklist. This action can be used for both scheduled data ingestion and on-demand retrieval.

parameters.title: Indicator Type
parameters.name: indicator_type
parameters.tooltip: Specify the indicator type to fetch from the Recorded Future risklist. Supported values are IP, Domain, URL, Hash, and Vulnerability.
parameters.description: Specify the indicator type to fetch from the Recorded Future risklist. Supported values are IP, Domain, URL, Hash, and Vulnerability.

parameters.title: Risk Rule
parameters.name: risk_rule
parameters.tooltip: Specify the optional risk rule name to filter indicators from a specific Recorded Future risklist. Leave this field blank to use the default master risklist for the selected indicator type.
parameters.description: Specify the optional risk rule name to filter indicators from a specific Recorded Future risklist. Leave this field blank to use the default master risklist for the selected indicator type.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of indicators to return. Leave this field blank to fetch all available indicators without any limit.
parameters.description: Specify the maximum number of indicators to return. Leave this field blank to fetch all available indicators without any limit.

operations.title: Get Risk Rules
operations.description: Retrieve the list of available risk rules for the specified indicator type.

parameters.title: Indicator Type
parameters.description: Specify the indicator type for which to retrieve available risk rules. Supported values are IP, Domain, URL, Hash, and Vulnerability.
parameters.name: indicator_type
parameters.tooltip: Specify the indicator type for which to retrieve available risk rules. Supported values are IP, Domain, URL, Hash, and Vulnerability.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.tooltip: Specify the IP address to perform an on-demand reputation lookup and retrieve threat intelligence details from Recorded Future.

parameters.title: Fields
parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of Recorded Future fields to include in the response. Leave blank to use the default fields: risk, intelCard, timestamps, counts, sightings.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of Recorded Future fields to include in the response. Leave blank to use the default fields: risk, intelCard, timestamps, counts, sightings.
